senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חמס) [to be hot,] to do violence, to wrong.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 35a:7">Snh. 35ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 1:17">Is. I, 17</cite>) <he>אשרו חָמוּץ ולא חוֹמֵץ</he> right the oppressed, but not the oppressor (listen to the complainant first); <cite ref="Yoma 39b">Yoma 39ᵇ</cite>
